node_definition.done_when: Read the plan section with read_plan(view='section', section='s12') before starting; it is the authority. The code is reckon/crew/dispatch.py: _lane_worker_allowance, the LaneHeld raise and change_lane. Add the new cases to tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py, building every lane document through the lane reader's own path. Re-cut test_no_dispatch_is_refused_held_or_rerouted_by_any_value_in_the_document in tests/test_lane_reading_at_dispatch.py, so it asserts the real hold rather than the dry run. Execute the named negative control. The gate is tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py plus every test file under tests/ that names change_lane, LaneHeld, worker_slots or headroom, found by a text search. Run it at base and at head and list the files in the manifest. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/the-local-lane-is-the-default/worker-slot-hold-is-tested-where-it-acts.html records the change. Run `date -u` first and treat that instant as your start; your deadline is 60 minutes later. Write your manifest before starting any long command. Run both gate arms with pytest-xdist (-n 8 --timeout=300), never serially. Run the base arm, from a `git archive` extraction of your base under /tmp in a directory named for this run, and then the head arm, each in the foreground: a background command dies when your turn ends. Keep the gate to the test files that reach your change, tens of files rather than hundreds. Each arm uses its own basetemp outside any repository and writes to its own new log path, which it never overwrites. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder. Each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed Python paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
